dedupe_keys.name: natural disasters in the lower mekong 1990 2015

description: Natural disasters in the Lower Mekong 1990-2015 is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Mekong. This dataset was built from search criteria on the EM-DAT database to find the number of floods, storms, droughts and earthquakes per years int he five Lower Mekong countries. Source: EM-DAT: The OFDA/CRED International Disaster Database – www. emdat. be – Université Catholique de Louvain – Brussels – Belgium. Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Mekong. Its tags are Disasters and emergency response. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2016-04-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
